title: Dooku
subtitle: It Is Too Late
text:
Hidden (This unit can't be attacked if it was played this phase.)
When Played: Each friendly unit with Hidden can't be attacked for this phase.
rules:
Dooku's "When Played" ability affects each friendly unit with Hidden, even if it entered play in a previous round.
If a unit has Hidden and Sentinel at the same time, it can be attacked.
